qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the fan clutch coupling nut on the water pump?
Which component uses the 1AZ specification code?
qa_pairs.answer: Fan clutch on water pump coupling nut (left-hand threads)

qa_pairs.question: What type of threads does the fan clutch coupling nut have?
What section of the manual is this torque specification from?
Does the 40 Nm torque specification apply to all engine types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, it applies to all engine types as indicated in the Type column

qa_pairs.question: What unit of measurement is used for the fan clutch torque specification?
Where is the fan clutch coupling nut located?
What is special about the threading on the fan clutch coupling nut?
qa_pairs.answer: It has left-hand threads, which means it tightens counterclockwise

qa_pairs.question: How many torque specifications are listed in the Fan subsection on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: One torque specification is listed - 40 Nm for the fan clutch coupling nut
